name: SPT-VR-ProVolver
teaser: Haptic feedback support for the ProVolver in SPT-VR.
description:
SPT-VR-ProVolver adds haptic feedback support for the ProVolver force-feedback gunstock in SPT-VR.

The mod detects weapon fire events in-game and translates them into physical recoil effects on ProVolver hardware. Recoil intensity is based on the weapon’s in-game characteristics. Different weapon classes feel distinct, and kick strength scales with the weapon’s recoil settings.

dependencies.name: SPT-VR
dependencies.teaser: SPT-VR brings the immersive, intense experience of Tarkov into the realm of virtual reality. Engage in intense firefights, loot dangerous environments, and survive the unforgiving world of Tarkov—all in full VR.

versions.description:
Hotfix Changelog:

  • Fixes an issue with not being able to extract after dying with the latest Fika

Quick Note - I know I’ve been pretty quiet/slow on updates for this mod lately. Kinda been obsessed with the side project with the clouds… but that’s now released into version 3.0.0 and it may even be the final version. So, any modding work I do going forward should just be on this VR mod.

NOTE: If you are experiencing crashes while using dynamic maps, remove the mod. Not sure what’s up with it but it is causing crashes for someone that tests this VR mod

Hotfix Changelog:

  • Added a patch to reduce VRAM usage of dynamic maps
  • Fixed the hang when opening the map with dynamic maps installed (this freeze actually happens on the flatscreen version of the mod too, it is just jarring in VR so I fixed it)
  • Removed eye adaptation

The removal of eye adaptation is pretty significant. Everything won’t get absurdly dark now when there’s an overcast. Eye adaptation usually just isn’t good in VR. Keep in mind, this will make nights considerably darker, tbh tarkov nights are a bit too bright anyway. I suggest using this mod too for darkness in interiors - https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/2613/reduce-fake-interior-shadows#description

Don’t forget to install my cloud mod if you haven’t already. I have it connected to this as a dependency.

1.2.4 Upcoming Changes

  • Clouds have now been removed from SPT-VR - Download it here, big update for it too! - https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/2567/cloudsix-cloud-replacement
  • Fixed DLSS/FSR quality changing mid-raid
  • Added support for Dynamic maps, the current version of Dynamic Maps has a few issues so you may see some nulls in your logs. Everything works though - Hold trigger and move to move the map around, hold trigger and move thumbstick up and down to zoom in/out

NOTE: Just to explain why I removed the clouds from SPT-VR - it just started getting confusing working with both of them moving changes between the two and testing on both. Separating it makes it so I just need to test them on flatscreen and if they’re working good there I know they’ll be good in VR. Also, this gives you the option of using older versions of my clouds.

Update Changelog:

NOTE: This build currently has a bug where DLSS/FSR quality will not change when changing the setting mid-raid. I have fixed this for the next update.

  • Adjustment to clouds, night will now have a base cloud color and brightness set. Having the night colors/brightness be based dynamically on the moon color wasn’t good and also hollywood graphics moon brightness adjustments made the clouds too bright
  • Artifacting around grass during winter season with ambient occlusion enabled fixed
  • Disabling DLSS will now work properly, it wasn’t working at all before
  • DLSS will not disable anymore while in inventory
  • Complete re-write of the upscaler quality selection, it’s much cleaner now
  • The above re-write fixes a really bad issue with DLSS that I didn’t notice, DLSS will now set the correct quality upon loading into hideout/raid

So regarding the last point, a tester noticed that when they turned DLSS off then back on mid-game, they would get better performance. After investigating this, I found that a bug was pretty much resetting your render resolution to 1x effectively gaining you no performance benefits. Disabling and re-enabling it would fix it. This is now resolved, so some people may notice a pretty good improvement in performance if you used DLSS.

NOTE: Just a reminder, if you are using SPT-VR, you don’t need my other two mods, AO Replacer and CloudSix. It’s built into SPT-VR because it requires it

Hotfix Changelog:

  • Various bug fixes to cloud code that wasn’t noticeable in-game
  • Fixed an issue where clouds didn’t spawn when going into your next raid
  • Fixed an issue where clouds weren’t appearing in scopes
  • Restored Tarkov’s cloud terrain shadows (they don’t line up with my clouds unfortunately but if you’re not paying attention to that it is a nice effect)
  • Fixed an issue where disabling DLSS wasn’t working
  • Adjusted AO to use Deferred/Gbuffer, this reduces the amount of AO you will see but it is a more accurate use of AO
  • Fixed an issue where setting TAA in graphics settings would break rendering
  • Fixed GPUInstancer frustum and occlusion culling in VR so the disable frustum and occlusion culling options in VR settings will be removed (tree’s still cull in the far right of your right eye, wasn’t able to figure out what culling is doing this)
  • Reduced a forced lodbiasfactor from 3 down to 1.5

About that last point - This has been forced to 3 for a while in the mod, I never paid much mind to it but when I was messing with that value in flatscreen, I noticed it would drop fps by 20-30 in some areas if set to 3. Unsure if this will have much of an effect on performance in VR though.

NOTE: If you are using Fika, update it! Extracting from raid will cause a crash if you’re not on the latest version of Fika

Update Changelog - The graphics update!

Just want to start by saying, this is mainly a graphics update for the mod to try and get things looking better. There’s two big parts of this update, new clouds, and new ambient occlusion method that is fully compatible with VR - GTAO. The clouds are using a totally custom made shader by me, I have spent a lot of time on this shader. Basically, it’s significantly more physically aware (I feel they look better than tarkov’s built in clouds at times). The GTAO completely replaces Tarkov’s AO and it works properly in VR, which means same shading in both eyes and it’s also a lot more accurate AO than Tarkov’s built in HBAO.

  • Improved upscaler support, just adjusted some things with jitter and the way things were being rendered which may improve quality (no more DLAA, to my surprise, DLAA actually uses a special wrapper that Tarkov does not support so it was not working properly)
  • Totally rewrote my custom cloud shader and scripting. It looks A LOT better now, the dome is now massive, you won’t see like the far buildings on customs behind the clouds anymore. Cloud lighting is fully dynamic based off the direction of the sun and color of sky/sun. Clouds are now being rendered directly through commandbuffer to avoid being effected by post fx, this keeps the clouds from being totally blown out
  • New AO implementation which totally replaces Tarkov’s AO. It’s now using GTAO instead of HBAO which is more accurate and also VR/Stereo compatible so you’ll see the shading the same in both eyes. To use it, just set the ambient occlusion setting in graphics tab to your preferred quality (colored ultra is the same as ultra)
  • Fixed Fika extract issue
  • Added support for new Fika loading bar
  • Fixed a long standing issue with MDR’s and possibly other guns getting stuck in animation if you med or eat while in inventory
  • New weapon weight system, it’s actually the best way to play now imo. It’s not as restrictive as it was, you’ll feel the weapon weight but if you pull/move your hand fast enough, it’ll respond much faster. So you’ll be able to make those quick adjustments without feeling like you’re pulling the gun through water
  • Re-added fog but I have it disabled by default, I’m going to look into a total fog replacement at some point. The fog I was using does not work nicely with the upscalers at all
  • Going prone no longer hides arms. Found out with Gbtonzee that my changes I made a while back to shoulder placement completely resolved the broken arms while prone
  • Dedicated in-game keyboard toggle - Thanks @mayoi for this! Check their github here - https://github.com/dasanibroto - Hope it helps people that can’t use the steamvr keyboard (they have another add-on they’re working on for sptvr that a lot of people have asked for )
